test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a national political party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Conference

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A registered party is recognized as a national party only if it satisfies any of the three conditions listed below:
 
• The party wins 2% of seats in the Lok Sabha from at least three different states.
 
• In a general election to the Lok Sabha or Legislative Assembly, the party receives 6% of the vote in any of four or more states and also wins four Lok Sabha seats.
 
• The party is recognized as a state party in four states.
